purpose: Disclosed capital_reinsurance inputs for measure_capital.py --live. Each row is a DISCLOSED fact: an AM Best/S&P/Fitch financial-strength rating plus the Solvency II SCR-coverage ratio from the entity's published SFCR. NO synthetic values — leave an entity OUT until you have its real, sourced figures. The script skips any entity not present here, so a partially-populated file is valid and the eval will reflect exactly the disclosed coverage achieved.

instructions.scr_coverage_pct: own funds / SCR x100, from the SFCR (number, e.g. 215). Omit if not disclosed (rating-only is allowed).
instructions.fsr_source: primary URL to the rating page (ambest.com / spglobal.com / fitchratings.com)
instructions.scr_source: primary URL to the published SFCR PDF/page
instructions.as_of: YYYY-MM-DD of the rating / SFCR reporting date
instructions.applies_to: risk-carriers only (insurer, lloyds_syndicate, reinsurer). Brokers/MGAs have no FSR/SCR and stay assessed by design.
